responsibility: This module is gigi, the GNU Ada front end’s interface layer to GCC: it integrates GNAT into the GCC build, driver, option, and language-hook framework, defines Ada-specific tree codes and metadata, and translates analyzed Ada entities, types, expressions, statements, and subprograms into GCC trees for later gimplification and optimization. Its core file families split the work between declaration/type lowering and Ada representation handling (decl, ada-tree, cuintp), executable construct translation and per-function code-generation state (trans), language hooks, startup, parsing entry points, and option processing (misc, lang-specs, lang.opt), target ABI/type queries needed by Ada semantics (targtyps), and shared support for attributes, builtin registration, tree utilities, alignment and expression analysis (utils, utils2). Together these files distinguish the module as the Ada-specific bridge from GNAT semantic structures to GCC’s generic middle end, including Ada language rules such as elaboration, unconstrained arrays, discriminants, representation details, and frontend-specific builtins.
